title: FabulouslyMOTD
description: Random + Colorful MOTD plugin for spigot-based servers.
body:
# FabulouslyMOTD
Credit: [SleepySpeller/DynamicallyMotd](https://github.com/SleepySpeller/DynamicallyMotd)

## Usage
`/fmotd [add|append|join]` to add a new motd. (Auto reload)

`/fmotd [delete|pop|remove]` to remove an exist motd. (Auto reload)

`/fmotd reload` to reload config.

## Config template
```yaml
# config.yml (Template)

motd:
  - '&7A Minecraft Server'
  - '&3Welcome join our server!'
```

Need an icon.
